title: XTRA POWER Wool Pad Super Buff for Polishing, 230 mm
description: XTRA POWER Wool Pad Super Buff for Polishing, 230 mm - Distributed/Packaged by Generic. Product Details: The XTRA POWER Wool Pad Super Buff is a premium polishing pad designed to deliver outstanding results on a variety of surfaces. Measuring 230 mm in diameter, this generously sized wool pad is ideal for use with polishing machines and is well-suited for automotive, industrial, and household polishing applications. The dense wool fibres work effectively to remove light scratches, swirl marks, and oxidation, leaving surfaces with a brilliant, high-gloss finish. The pad is engineered to distribute polishing compounds evenly, ensuring consistent and smooth results across the entire surface. Its robust construction ensures durability and long-lasting performance even under regular, heavy-duty use. Compatible with standard backing plates, this wool buff pad is a reliable choice for both professional detailers and DIY enthusiasts looking to achieve a showroom-quality finish. Whether you are working on car bonnets, panels, or other large surfaces, the XTRA POWER Wool Pad Super Buff makes the task efficient and effective.
